_provenance.redaction: D-03 discipline: template texts are preserved verbatim (they are the mimicry target); the question/reply texts are shape-preserving stand-ins (<question>, <reply>).
_provenance.policy: D-01 (12-CONTEXT): an unanswered AskUserQuestion waits a configurable interval (default 10 minutes; 0 = block forever — interactive mode), then returns a capture-shaped non-answer. The non-answer form remains CORPUS-ABSENT (see the hunt note) and follows the documented corpus-informed-default convention.
corpus_absent: ask_non_answer_form — HUNT (12-05, 2026-08-20): a HELD interaction (client connected, no answer sent) produced NO self-timeout in 600s — zcode's runtime does not fire its 30s ask timeout while a client holds the request pending; the auto-resolution path is gated on PERSISTED runtime settings (readPersistedAutoResolution), not the headless prefs reply, and was not headless-reachable. ass-guard's D-01 default (internal/session/ask.go RenderAskNonAnswer) stands as the documented corpus-informed default; the target's own non-answer text exists in its bundle but is NOT capture-pinned (the captured-not-written doctrine).

ask_question_client_surface_form — the client-side rendering of the question is UI-side, not part of request/response captures; the surface renderer (coreexec.RenderAskSurface) emits structure (header, question, option labels with descriptions), not judgment — the '(Recommended)' first-option convention is left to the model per the captured schema's own usage notes.
ask_input_keys_live — RESOLVED by the 12-05 re-record: observed input key set = {questions} (the schema-declared shape confirmed live).

You can now start coding. Start with updating your todo list if applicable. ## Approved Plan: <plan>') — flagged corpus_absent, never capture-pinned.
